title: The features underlying the memorability of objects
caption_short: The released quantity: corrected recognition (hit rate minus false-alarm rate) for each of the 1,854 THINGS concepts, sorted from most to least memorable, with example images; the task itself was an online continuous-recognition stream (press when an image repeats) and is described in the paper's Methods, not drawn.
notes: The original paper contains no task-paradigm figure (its figures are analyses); Figure 1A shows the released memorability scores. Cropped from the publisher PDF page 4.
